98000.description:
The school comedy focuses on the Psychometrer character Mitsuru Fukushima, who has fallen into debt because of his love of cosplay. He plans to commit suicide in the forest around Mount Fuji, but he encounters the dead body of a female teacher named Mitsuko Fukushima who looks just like him. He begins life anew in women's clothing, helping to reform delinquent students.

(Source: Anime News Network)

98001.description:
Every Friday, forbidden tales will be revealed.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

98006.description: Nian Bing is the son of a fire mage and an ice mage. After both of his parents were killed by the Ice Lord, Nian Bing received both of his parents' magic gems. When Nian Bing was trying to escape from the Ice Lord's followers, he managed to cast both fire and ice magic at the same time. An impossible feat for a mage. He fell from the cliff, unconscious, and was saved by an oldman. After he woke up, the oldman gave him a food so delicious he never tasted before. It turned out that the oldman was a genius chef, once called a spirit chef. And he wants Nian Bing to be his disciple no matter what! Is Nian Bing able to seek vengeance while aiming to become the greatest chef?
synonyms: The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice

title.english: The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice: Season 1

98007.description:
1. Sore kara, Kimi wo Kangaeru (それから、君を考える)
In a small, boring countryside town with nothing to do are Takashi and Yasu. They've been friends since childhood, always together. Still the closest of friends, even in high school. However. Yasu holds feelings for Takashi that go beyond friendship. Without Yasu being able to put his feelings into words, the season changes to exam season, and Takashi confesses that he'll be taking exams for Tokyo University...

2. Saigo no Meirei (最後の命令)
3. Young Oh! Oh!
4. Yoakemae ga Ichiban Kurai (夜明け前が一番暗い)
synonyms: Từ ấy tôi đã biết tương tư

98008.description: A powerful grand wizard named, “Raim” reappears after a millennium because of a failed experiment. While sets out to regain his lost tower, he meets “are” and “ere” who have been trafficked as slaves... a combination of a weird grand magician who only uses his wits to make money and the cute, lovable brother and sister of the Miao​ tribe! Their endless adventure is beginning to unfold.

98009.description:
A collection of intertwining stories covering four not-quite lovers as they find what links them together.

Akiba plays the piano and reminisces about Yahiko, a friend with benefits he can't quite bring himself to call his lover, despite how freely the man cares for him.

Despite their constant bickering, Sado and Nakajo appear close enough to be lovers. But Nakajo has convinced himself he can never have Sado, which leads him to stay by his side while simultaneously looking for ways to hate him.

Shibata is an overly friendly older man who rather insistently hits on Sekiya, a socially awkward radio DJ. Even with his radio DJ persona, Sekiya has a hard time expressing the roil of emotions within him.

Kameda and Ogikawa get to know each other thanks to a stray cat. The two spend lazy days together, eating, drinking, and playing with their cat, all without calling it love.

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

98010.description: When Iga gets in charge of a small garden project in a rural area two hours away from Tokyo as an order by his father, he considers it a demotion, since he already had success in big, important plans. While trying to figure out why his father seems to think so little of him, his meeting with the representative of the project Asakura Yuu, a young but very kind man, helps him find the lost drive for his work and cope with the various problems in his life. On the other hand, Yuu feels as if he only receives help from Iga and tries to match up to him.

98011.description:
"Today Kanai-kun is absent from school.
Kanai-kun has passed away.
Who was Kanai-kun?
Was he actually here?"

A quiet story about one of the great existential questions in life.

98012.description: Shouta Oone was feeling that his daily school life had become dull. In the midst of his boredom, he coincidentally ends up learning the outrageous secret of his classmate, Ichigo Otohime! This is a bittersweet youth story, adorned with a secret that mustn't be leaked!

98013.description:
From the sands of Ancient Egypt to the streets of modern Japan, the newly resurrected Great Priest Imhotep traverses time and space on the hunt for the magai, devious beings with an appetite for destruction who impersonate the gods! When schoolgirl Hinome crosses paths with this illustrious ancient, is her loner lifestyle about to change for the better...or for the worse?!

(Source: Yen Press)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Im (pilot)

98014.description:
Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo’s journey has only just begun! This manga adaptation of the hit light novel series features charming artwork by manga artist Tomowo Maruyama, and is sure to be enjoyed by existing fans of the franchise as well as all-new readers who are ready for a sharp fantasy tale.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Was a Sword When I Reincarnated

98015.description: Two radio hosts finish their second show and are getting ready to head home. However, one has a different idea...

98016.description:
Fuka had to take the job of a live-in housekeeper due to unforeseen circumstances. But it turns out to be the home of her mean classmate, Kairi! Moreover, the Saioji family consists four brothers who are nothing alike...? The oldest brother, Tsukasa, is calm and mature, the second boy, Akari, is an affectionate playboy, the third boy, Kairi, is a genius with a prideful temperament, and the youngest, Minato, is quiet and cute. The four brothers are each unique and handsome in their own way, and they're all living under one roof with Fuka!

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes six special and extras chapters.

title.native: 斎王寺兄弟に困らされるのも悪くない
title.romaji: Saiouji Kyoudai ni Komarasareru no mo Warukunai

98017.description: Koume, who has always admired the rumored "princess carry" is in her first year of high school. On her way to school, he meets a boy, Daisuke, who's extremely athletic, but extremely small. The only thing big is his attitude. Our first impressions suck! Plus, we're in the same volleyball club. I can't believe it's with Daisuke, or so I thought, but my heart won't stop thumping hard. What is this?

98018.description:
The manga adapts the story of Sound Horizon's Märchen album. The story centers on the reclusive Therese von Ludowing, a woman who is able to craft herbal remedies, but is apprehended as a witch. With Therese's son murdered, and herself facing execution, she curses the world, and is reborn after her execution as Märchen von Friedhof. She begins her quest to exact revenge.

(Source: Anime News Network)

98019.description:
Full Drum is a rugby-themed work about a high school boy named Hino who has been repeatedly kicked out of all the clubs he joined thanks to his lack of athletic ability. The protagonist Hino has dirty thoughts of becoming popular with girls by entering a sports club. One day, he meets a rugby club manager named Ayako. After becoming totally fascinated with Ayako, Hino decides to join the rugby club.

(Source: Manga Tokyo)

98020.description:
Closet idol fan, Mikado, hates his superior, Anezaki. Anezaki is very capable in his work, but he hands all the grunt work to Mikado. One day, Mikado is charged with sending a drunk Anezaki home after a company drinking party. But they missed the last train and end up spending the night at a love hotel. There, Anezaki suddenly mounts Mikado and continues to do the dirtiest things.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: The Secret of Me and My Boss

title.native: 俺と上司のかくしごと

98021.description: When a small town is affected by the recession, its residents blame their misfortune on the god who resides at a temple in a nearby mountain. Another resident of the temple, a fox spirit called Gin is angered that the humans are blaming his master, but eventually learns to develop some compassion towards humans.

98022.description:
"Since it's destiny, it can't be helped..."

Tachibana Kaito, 21 years old, waiter at a restaurant, suddenly met, who he'd thought, was his destined lover. It was love at first sight for him, but this beautiful person ended up being... a man.

Kataoka Isuke, 19 years old, student of digital arts.
So what'll happen to those two? Is it really destiny or was it just a fluke?
synonyms: Good Morning, Good Night and Then

title.native: おはようとおやすみとそのあとに
title.romaji: Ohayou to Oyasumi to Sono Ato ni

98023.description:
The serial killer is laughing in the rain. Punishment: Dog Food—. Punishment: Know your mother’s pain—. Punishment: one split evenly—. Punishment: Forever beautiful—. The Frog Man from Hell executes his "punishments" ...

(Source: Kodansha USA)
Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Onna to Koroshiya (Girl and Killer)
Volume 3: Bokura wa Shinyuu to Iu Karada de (3 chapters)
synonyms: Bokura wa Shinyuu to Iu Tei de
The Serial Killer Is Laughing in the Rain
Muzeum. Seryjny morderca śmieje się w deszczu
Музей. Серійний вбивця, що сміється під дощем
Museum: O Assassino ri na Chuva
Muzej: Serijski ubica se smeje na kiši

98024.description: Sato and Hiyoko's trip to the hot springs.

98025.description: Ever since he was a child, Maeda Taiki looked plain and shabby, and has never been popular. For these reasons, he wanted to at least have a good sense of fashion as an adult. So before he knew it, he became a shop attendant at a fashion mall. He has now found someone that he likes…. an employee at the fashion mall's main department, Yagii Haruhisa. Not only is Yagii kind and handsome, he's friendly with everyone he meets. He's someone that Maeda simply can't help but admire. However, Maeda is aware that he doesn't stand a chance of loving someone like Yagii… That is, until an awkward question from Maeda causes Yagii to steal his first kiss?!
synonyms: จุมพิตหวานปานลูกกวาด

98026.description: Short, smutty story of a relationship between twins.

98027.description:
Setou Yuu is a 12-year-old boy, despite being very intelligent, he is a deprived person. Abused violently by his father and beaten by debt collectors regularly due to his father, his body filled with scars. One day, he is transported into a different world and he got what he needed to strike back at those who harm him or his loved ones.

(Source: Rebirth Online World)

title.native: 奪う者 奪われる者

98028.description:
The current world no longer has any need of special powers. Thus, witches have lost their value and are not that different from humans. That's why Misty lives a normal life with her fellow witches, Eve and Baba Yaga, while earning a living as a BL genre comic artist. One day, a mysterious group kidnaps Misty and all of a sudden their once normal life turns "abnormal!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

98029.description: Tsukasa Mutou just started to live on his own. Moving in he finds a tree growing into his room, leading him to meet an "interesting" neighbor with a flourishing garden. Tsukasa begins spending more time at the home of his neighbor, Uemitsu, feeling drawn to more than just the beauty of the garden.

98030.description:
A Japanese high school student is on his way to a Dragon Ball event with a friend. Suddenly, he sees a cute girl wearing a short skirt, but when he runs over to get a closer look, he trips and gets knocked out. Upon waking up, he realizes he's turned into Yamcha from Dragon Ball. Being an avid fan of the series, he knows what lies ahead in Yamcha's future, thus he decides to take matters into his own hands, in order to change Yamcha's fate.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.
synonyms: Dragon Ball Side Story: The Case of Being Reincarnated as Yamcha
Dragon Ball Side Story - Reborn as Yamcha
Dragon Ball Side Stories: Wiedergeboren als Yamchu
Dragon Ball Spin-off - Aquella vez que me reencarné en Yamcha
Dragon Ball Gaiden: Aquela Vez Que Reencarnei Como Yamcha

title.english: Dragon Ball: That Time I Got Reincarnated as Yamcha!
title.native: ドラゴンボール外伝　転生したらヤムチャだった件
title.romaji: Dragon Ball Gaiden: Tensei-shitara Yamcha Datta Ken

98036.description:
Hino-kun is good-looking and a rumored delinquent. Actually, he is a kind-hearted high school student who looks after his young nephew. He can see that Mizusawa-kun is good at making sweets so for the sake of his fatherless nephew, he asks him to, "Please marry my older sister!" But instead, he receives a reverse proposal from Mizusawa saying, "I want to marry you."…?!

Source: MyAnimeList

98037.description:
Jousei Tsubakiya is a rich law school student. Motoki Sakurai is the most popular guy in the education department. Together, they're the hottest guys around, and totally irresistible to ladies. After a party with no hot girls, with both of them drunk, they decide to go to a love hotel...! It was supposed to be a lark, but to Motoki's surprise, Jousei gets a hard-on. Motoki starts to give him a hand job and ends up getting hard, too. His curiosity piqued, things start to escalate until reason goes out the window, and before you know it, they've done the deed...!

These party legends are facing an existential crisis! Their relationship starts to morph, but is it love, or friendship...?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: The chapter count includes the one-shots Bijo to Yajuu ( 美女と野獣) and Hentaigakari.

title.native: ハングアウトクライシス

98038.description:
Yakushamaru Hiroko has big plans for herself, and she's come to Studio Pulp, the home of the stars, to make them a reality. However, there seems to be some kind of misunderstanding.
Many familiar faces return in this comedy that never had a fourth wall to break in the first place. Welcome to Studio Pulp.

98039.description:
I didn't know there were so many kinds of "sweetness" before meeting Hanae-san.

(Source: Batoto)

Included one-shots:
Suki to Kiss de Tsunagatte.
Yoi Ko Warui Ko Itoshii Ko
synonyms: I do not know such a sweet thing…

title.native: こんな甘いこと、知らない…っ。

98040.description:
Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Osu Shiikuchuu! (オス・飼育中!)."
- Includes the one shots "Ouji-sama wo Hitorijime. (王子様を独りじめ。)" and "Yarashii Ase ka Iteru!? (やらしい汗かいてる!?)," and an extra chapter.

98041.description:
"Love" and "affection" are too much of a burden for Jiro, so he doesn't need them. He gets his kicks from sex, but when things cool down, it's all over. While at work, Jiro reunites with his classmate from college, Toua, who's a model that got his job by lying on his resume. In exchange for Jiro keeping quiet about it, they have sex, and this is the start of their "special relationship." But, it turns out that Toua is a rude guy with no brain-to-mouth filter who sleeps around. Even though Jiro understands that Toua has many flaws that cannot be fixed, they are frustratingly perfect for each other in bed... All Jiro knows about Toua is just where to touch him, but not much else. This is the debut manga for the highly-touted author Ari Uehara! Includes four digital-only pages.

(Source: Renta!)

98042.description: The oldest of the twins, Ikurou, is at the top of his year in academics. While the younger brother, Akaya, is below average, and Ikurou holds a superiority complex with him. However, when he feels Akaya’s gaze on him, he is reminded of what happened five years ago, when Akaya asked him, “Can I touch you,” and Ikurou feels driven into a corner. When he finally snaps and scolds Akaya, he just casually changes his lifestyle and says that he will surpass his older brother in grades. And thus a bet is placed, with the promises of a reward...

98043.description:
Seven Japanese high school prodigies have taken the world by storm, exercising their mind-blowing abilities in everything from politics to entertainment. But when their plane crashes one day, these geniuses awaken to find themselves in a different realm-one that's home to magic and beast folk! While such strange new surroundings might throw an average person for a loop, these prodigies take their situation in stride...and then some! With the greatest minds and talents known to Earth, this dream team is about to turn the other world on its head!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.
synonyms: Сверхстаршеклассники все-таки могут выжить в ином мире!
High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World
Super high school students, even in a foreign world, survive easily!
The Super High Schoolers Affording to Live in Another World!
Super Human High Schoolers Are in Another World, But Seem to be Living in Comfort!
ึ7 เทพม.ปลายกับการใช้ชีวิตสบายๆในต่างโลก

title.native: 超人高校生たちは異世界でも余裕で生き抜くようです！

title.romaji: Choujin Koukousei-tachi wa Isekai demo Yoyuu de Ikinuku you desu!

98046.description:
University student Sahara, with his horrible luck, loses his home when his entire apartment goes up in flames. Luckily, he is able to stay at a friend's place. But he is suddenly mistaken as a suspicious person by his friend's older brother, Masaki. They manage to dispel the misunderstanding, but he is pressured into doing an unimaginable job...

(Source: Yaoi Desire Revolution)

98047.description:
Don't let the cute face fool you... This guy's a complete pervert!! Yoji Kuroe, a graphic design student at Mishima Design Academy, approaches fashion student Toma Kishida to request some cosplay costumes. However, the price - $1,000 - is a bit out of Yoji's range... That's when Toma makes Yoji an offer he can't resist: he'll waive the fee altogether if Yoji models for him. Yoji agrees and ends up in... skin-tight full-body spandex...! Thus, a mutually beneficial(!?) arrangement escalates into a skin-tight, heart-throbbing battle of wills!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes four digital-only pages.

title.native: 一枚越しフェティッシュ

98048.description: A romantic comedy about a high school boy named Gen and an older girl named Chion who is living at Gen's family's temple in the countryside.
synonyms: La fille du temple aux chats

98049.description:
High school student Takeru Sumura has a dark secret: his parents were murdered by demons. Consumed by vengeance, Takeru seeks out the famed demon hunter, Ludwig van Beethoven. Beethoven is a "magia," a wizard who wields the power of music to battle demons. Taken under Beethoven's wing, Takeru joins the ranks of other renowned magia: Bach, Mozart, Shubert, Liszt and Tchaikovsky. This unique team of demon hunters will use their music-based magic to combat the world's demons. Now all Takeru needs to do is figure out how to convince Beethoven to upgrade him from his personal cleaning boy to a full-fledged apprentice!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

98050.description:
The continuation of the Light Novel Ayanashi no Kimi.

Time is peace. A girl, Itsuki, who can cleanse the souls spirit by kissing them, is prohibited from “Kissing with Humans” one day by the aristocratic youth who takes over herself, Katsuragi. A peace romance of love and death over the men around us.

title.native: 平安恋絵巻 あやなしの君
title.romaji: Heian Koi Emaki: Ayanashi no Kimi

98052.description:
"Are you going commando?" Due to unforeseen circumstances, Ryo Kishimoto winds up freeballing it on the way to school one day... and against all odds, his younger teammate Haruma Nojima winds up with some major blackmail material. From that day on, Ryo is forced to live without underpants. He even has to wear a bra along with other less savory accessories... Haruma keeps ramping up the naughtiness, and despite his earlier reluctance, Ryo starts to enjoy it...! What fate lies in store for Ryo and his underwear? This is a freeballing love story about two high-school students!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Underwear Is Being Held Hostage
title.native: 俺のパンツが人質に取られています
title.romaji: Ore no Pants ga Hitojichi ni Torarete Imasu

98053.description:
Riku Miike is the most popular model in the men's fashion magazine "TAG" right now. He's a very optimistic, happy-go-lucky kind of guy, but one day he messes up big time. Ikumi Hashimoto is the associate editor of "TAG" and his standoff-ish behavior worries Riku. However, realizing that Ikumi hasn't ever given up on him, Riku gets curious. Following that, he gets to see Ikumi show a completely new side to him as he ends up blushing at a very close distance...

(Source: Renta!)

98054.description:
Sun Hwa is a BL artist using his room as a secret base to draw his work. One day, he gets caught working on his comic by a handsome blond man. Later, he finds out that this man is the new baker on the first floor. But there's just more to this man than simply his looks.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Baker on the First Floor

98055.description:
With rapid developments to the human civilization, the need for God and his angels have decreased at a significant rate. Thus, the angels are experiencing a historic unemployment crisis! With this problem in hand, God decides to start a company that will reduce the unemployment rate in both Heaven and Hell. He hereby founds the company, H&H Roman Company!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes a prologue and five side story chapters.

98057.description: A heartwarming collection of stories  about food.
synonyms: Doko ka de dare ka mo Tabete iru

title.native: どこかでだれかも食べている

98061.description:
A high school boy whose heart doesn't beat meets a man that stirs up his heart.

(Source: Foxtoon, translated)

98062.description:
The manga centers on 17-year-old protagonist Gekitetsu Amō, who does not stand out in school, but under the excuse of "eliminating harmful elements from the world" begins committing mass murder.

Source: Anime News Network

title.english: Cruel Method to Make the World Better
title.romaji: Sekai o Yoku Suru Zankoku na Method

98064.description: Tsuki is beginning her first year at a high school far from home. More than romance, she's just interested in making friends. The first friend she makes, Nobara, is a standoffish and secretive girl - but why do her tears look like candy?

98065.description:
When the sudden death of famous women's shoe designer Yuliya sends shockwaves through the fashion world, one androgynous boy in high heels takes her place - Yuliya's only son, Yuli. In just five years, Yuli turns his family's declining shoe brand into a brand only the rich and famous ever wear, but what's behind all this sudden success? Behind the flashy lights, Yuli offers himself up for wealthy patrons, with nobody but his trusted assistant Adam by his side. But there's one more secret Yuli isn't telling anyone - the one behind all of Yuli's successful designs is Adam!

(Source: Futekiya)

98066.description:
He’s a dark, uber-powerful god-level demon…who’s also really helpful around the house. Welcome to the unique world of Ghost Wife, where an average high school girl can go to sleep with normal teenage problems, only to wake up and find herself married to an over-protective demon with a creepy smile and an appetite for live cats.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

98067.description:
Occasionally, there are girls who appear in BL. Sometimes they act as rivals; sometimes as bystanders, or even a person who understands relationships between men.

This is an anthology of stories using the girls' point of view. Through their eyes and feelings, the boys' love will be painfully passed on.

Cover Illustration: Hideyoshico
1. Shoujo C (少女C) [Hideyoshico]: sequel to High School☆Lullaby published in Gesu BL
2. Tamai-san, Koi to Yuujou (玉井さん、恋と友情) [Takako Shimura]: sequel to Okite Saisho ni Suru Koto wa
3. Donyoku na Hana (貪欲な花) [Higashi Nishida]
4. Kami no Doutokuron-teki Shoumei (神の道徳論的証明) [Fumiko Fumi]
5. Watashitachi wa Byplayer (わたしたちはバイプレーヤー) [Harada]
6. Hai Hai, Kawaii ne (はいはい、かわいいね) [Mebaru Kobato]
7. Naturaturaly (ナチュラチュラリィ) [Kei Ichikawa]
8. Stockholm (ストックホルム) [Nozo Itoi]
9. Taneda-kun to Tsukiaitai (種田くんと付き合いたい) [Tamekou]
10. Oribon-chan to Otokonoko (おりぼんちゃんと男の子) [Puruchome]

98068.description:
All of a sudden, out of nowhere. "Renya Kunugi, you have passed away!" So said the young girl who styled herself God. Apparently, Renya Kunugi the protagonist had lived long and prospered. His life already came to a peaceful and fulfilling end, but at the request of Her Holiness, he was transported to an alternate world to start a new life as a young man. Thus did Renya, who was definitely your average everyday guy, end up fighting off bandits and vanquishing monsters. Eventually, after his successively blossoming talents coalesce into a force of sheer awesomeness, he will go on to leave his mark upon this alternate world.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

title.native: 二度目の人生を異世界で
title.romaji: Nidome no Jinsei wo Isekai de

98070.description: Su Shuang Shuang comes home one day to find that someone has moved into the apartment next to hers. When curiosity gets the best of her and she goes in to meet her neighbour, a handsome guys comes out of the shower? And he calls the police?

98071.description: The plot involves a young man who becomes a killer (by accident) – but his victim has the power of “postponement,” temporarily delaying her death.

title.native: いたいのいたいの、とんでゆけ
title.romaji: Itai no Itai no, Tonde Yuke

98072.description:
Wooseung, an art student who's only now delving into the dating scene, falls head over heels for Sunjin, the ever-so-charming upperclassman. Imagine Wooseung dreaming up classic romantic scenes, only to find out Sunjin's idea of a relationship is... let's just say… more physical. And it’s not Sunjin's fault! He can't help it when Wooseung is just so freaking cute. From picture-perfect romantic dreams to Sunjin's hands-on approach, Wooseung's in for a wild ride!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: includes 20 extra chapters. This work was first serialised in Lezhin before it got discontinued and moved to Series Naver. There is an adult version and a non-adult version.

title.english: All About Lust: Where We Started

98074.description: A high school girl reincarnates in another world as Lily. While she occasionally reminisces about her past life, she is now known as "the Maid of the Royal Family," after helping to rear the lady who eventually married the crown prince. One day, the court magician Leonard suddenly requests that she acts as a mother for his adopted daughter Jill.

title.native: メイドから母になりました

98075.description:
Sakura is young wife. A bit rustic, loves cosplay and constantly brings her husband problems.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

98076.description:
A new maid sets out to befriend the aloof young master in this fantasy world. Follow them on their daily adventures.

(Source: Smack Jeeves)
synonyms: เมดสาวหน้าใสกับคุณชายปากร้าย

title.english: The Young Master and the Maid

98082.description: Brilliant usage of modern media for antismoking campaign. Park Hyung Suk from Lookism makes an appearance.

98083.description:
What is it that you desire? Money? Love? Walk again? Be stronger?
Whatever it is you wish for, you can get by asking the legendary and awe-inspiring "Demon's Plan"; a sacred object capable of granting anything to "the chosen ones."

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Nigashi-ya
Volume 2: Brain Breaker

98084.description: Listen to this. While we were at a Yakitori place talking about otaku stuff, we were blown into an alternate world. You may not believe what we are saying, but what is more unbelievable is that there are no girls in this world!! None! Nada! Zilch!!! Auuuugggghhhh! A bunch of good-looking dudes who like yuri: Kagome, Fuuga, Kamakura, Sakuragaoka, Ototachibana, Musashino, Hanadera. How are they going to live in a world full of only dudes!? It’s full-on survival of the fittest! Not! So it’s just your average unusual manga! Rest assured!

98086.description: Detective Hishima's lover is a former colleague and detective, Enokizu. He is still sore over an unresolved incident from 3 years ago that caused Enokizu to quit his job as a detective. The story of a heart-throbbing, imperfect love.

98087.description: Tarou was just an ordinary university student until a strange old magician summoned him to another world. Upon learning that his newly acquired magical power is 8 million (8 million more powerful than an average magician), he uses his abnormally powerful magic to revive the old man that caused all this... in the form of a frog. Thus begin the strange adventures of a boy with ridiculous magical power and Kawazu, the former strongest magician, now revived as a frog.
synonyms: Chronicles of My Adventures in Another World With Kawazu-san
Ore to Kaeru-san no Isekai Hourouki
Le récit de mes aventures dans un nouveau monde avec Kawazu-san

title.native: 俺と蛙さんの異世界放浪記
title.romaji: Ore to Kawazu-san no Isekai Hourouki

98088.description:
Hibiki thinks he's got everything figured out, but someone else knows a little more...

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)

98097.description:
"A romantic campus love story about a gay soccer star and his regained first love!"

The campus soccer star Hyun-Ho runs into his first love Gyul at the university. Back then in middle school, Gyul saw Hyun-Ho as a friend and never learned about his feelings. Hyun-Ho, still in love with the withdrawn Gyul, lends him a helping hand. Because Gyul's aunt is taking advantage of him, Gyul has to support his younger brother. To thank Hyun-Ho, Gyul helps him navigate university assignments. What starts out as a caring friendship, soon flourishes into a romantic relationship. But then, Hyun-Ho receives an offer to play abroad in the major league. Will Hyun-Ho and Gyul be able to overcome this hardship, too?

(Source: Netcomics)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

98098.description:
A bustling city, crowded streets... But always would the night fall... And when it does, in those dark corners, who is staring out unnervingly? Who is laughing hauntingly? How many secrets, how many tears are silently echoing in this endlessly lonely void?

Source: Manga Updates

98099.description:
A gene-altered assassin with the ability to transform into a bobcat faces off against a mysterious two-faced gentleman who appears to act with no rhyme or reason. But why does this man seem so familiar?

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

98100.description: Luna has been keeping her powers a secret from other people. One day, she initiates a fire in her house for being distracted, and is there when she comes to know that she's actually a witch. after that, She's summoned by her grandmother and goes to an island to train as a witch... a story about a modern witch and werewolf is about to begin.

98101.description:
This is a collection of short stories depicting the beginnings of love by Nakamura Hinata. Four cute and tender stories to bring a smile to your face.

1. Kedaruge na Kimi no Kirakira to
2. Kocchi Muite, Shiomi-kun
3. Amatou-kun to Koi no Aji
4. Kimi no Seal wo Atsumetai

(Source: Batoto)
synonyms: Kedaruge na Kimi no Kirakira to

98102.description:
Every guy on Earth has a secret folder filled with sensitive material, don't they? See what's inside this "Secret X Folder". The creator of the highly acclaimed "Drug Candy" has come back new and improved with more mature graphics, enhanced drawings, and more laughs to go around!

(Source: Lezhin)

98103.description:
Though no one in school aware of it, Ootaki-kun, a first year high school student, is a big fan of 80's songs and idols. One day, he found out that his classmate that sits next to him, Yakushimaru-chan, has the same interests as him...

Note: Includes a prologue.
synonyms: Une fois de plus au ralenti

title.native: スローモーションをもう一度

98109.description:
An omnibus collection of short stories.

Includes chapter 19-β / 19.5.

98110.description:
Woojin, a kid born with a silver spoon, goes to a night club, as usual, to seek out someone to enjoy a one night stand. As usual, he meets a sexy girl just ripe for the taking. However, this time, this girl isn't your ordinary girl. In fact, she's not even a normal human! Based on what she's saying, neither is Woojin!

(Source: Lezhin US)

98111.description: A manga following the activities of the 5 members of the hit idol group Momoiro Clover Z

98112.description:
Okazaki Miku is a “gal”: a fun-loving high school student who expresses herself through bleached hair, sexy clothes, and heaps of accessories. Unfortunately, she’s also flunking every class. When she asks her Home Economics teacher, Yabe Shinji, to help her bake bribery cookies for her disappointed teachers, she finds a new excitement in that small success–and Shinji is moved by her enthusiasm. Shinji decides to start a cooking club to better connect with his students, and Miku is first in line to join!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ครัวสาวแกล

98113.description:
Eunsung one day wakes up to find out he's a girl! He's able to hide his change of gender from everyone... or so he thought. His secret is discovered by his crush on day one and moreover, she asks him to pose as a nude model for her! How will Eunsung's life start anew as a girl?

Source: Lezhin

98114.description:
I was never curious about my girlfriend's past...until that incident! Now I'm just dying to know! Who is this ex-boyfriend? Why is he acting so friendly? What happened between them in the past?! It sure isn't your typical love triangle.

(Source: Lezhin US)

98115.description:
Ever thought of having an elder sister or younger sister? This is the story of such a household of sisters.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

98116.description: Sou Kagura is enjoying his life as a new high school student until one day when his parents abandon him due to a large debt they had amassed. To get rid of their debt, they essentially sell him to Mikoto Ouzuki, a wealthy land developer who wants Sou as his sexual pet. However, Sou's older sister Ui intervenes with a proposal: If Sou can pay back the debt in one year, he's off the hook, to which Ouzuki agrees. What Sou only finds out later on is that Ui's plan is to open up a maid cafe with him as one of the maids under the name "Kanade".

98117.description:
Former exemplary knight Hans was transferred to a small knight station in a rural town. Despite his many achievements, he hated the hustle and bustle of the imperial capital, and he was enjoying his quiet and peaceful life at his regional knight station. Then one day, Japanese people with superhuman abilities suddenly appeared from another world...! Former exemplary knight Hans is at the mercy of unbelievable Japanese people in this isekai knight station fantasy!

(Source: Alpha Manga)
synonyms: The Suffering of Local Knight Hans
The Misfortunes of Local Knight Hans
The Ordeals of Regional Knight Hans

title.english: The Ordeals of Regional Knight Hans
title.native: 地方騎士ハンスの受難

98118.description: Konoe Yuuto is a genius martial artist who is summoned to a different world where slave trading is legal. There, using his "Skill Taker" cheat ability, he steals the abilities of monsters he defeats, and starts building a slave harem while hoping to live a carefree life after retirement.
synonyms: Skill Taker’s World Domination: Building a Slave Harem from Scratch

title.native: 異世界支配のスキルテイカー~ゼロから始める奴隷ハーレム~
title.romaji: Isekai Shihai no Skill Taker: Zero kara Hajimeru Dorei Harem

98119.description: Sadaki Kaoru, an earnest Literature professor who comes from a prestigious academy, hides in his heart the one-sided feelings he has for someone. One day, thanks to drawing the attention of the school troublemaker ‘Shou, the informant’ his secret is revealed. In exchange for Shou’s silence, he’ll have no choice but to have sex ‘till the point of exhaustion. The day-to-day of being raped by a young student begins!

98120.description: Killer Tomato and Overripe Banana share their unique views on politics, lazy stock clerks, unattended children, rude customers and being eaten as they go from store to refrigerator.

title.native: キラートマトと完熟バナナ

98122.description:
Every 20 years, a secretive game is held, in which participants duke it out in a battle royale with sorcery, weaponry and hand to hand combat.

Over a hundred different Japanese sorcery associations participate, sending a single Master each to compete. Night by night these participants fight, and take the lives of one another.

One participant is Maiko Mizumaki. She enters the tournament in order to save the life of her dear friend, Hino, who has been afflicted by an Anomaly. In order to save the life of her friend she must survive until the end and obtain the strongest Anomaly Sandalphon.

98123.description:
On a hot summer afternoon, Hayato meets the new transfer student, Souma, who has not been able to adapt to the new environment. Hayato always manages to be in Souma’s sight and thinks that he will be able to take care of him. The familiar touch allows Souma to familiarize with the environment until he’s able to smile again. Meanwhile, Hayato tries to fix his past mistakes.

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

98124.description: Uda Natsumi, the owner of a food truck, finds himself becoming interested in one of his regular customers: a quiet, handsome young man who drops by after work to try out Uda's sweets and often ends up falling asleep at the counter.
synonyms: The Same Time as Always The Same Place as Always.

title.native: いつもの時間、いつもの場所で。
title.romaji: Itsumo no Jikan, Itsumo no Basho de.

98125.description: Replicants are beings made by humans in their own image. Such a replicant boy called Kip and his childhood friend Sierra somehow escape from Mars' concentration camp and together they seek a young man that escaped before them. However, what follows is their encounter with a man called Nailheart -- a replicant who hunts other replicants.

title.native: ヒエラルキーに泳ぐ深海魚は夢を見る
title.romaji: Hierarchy ni Oyogu Shinkaigyo wa Yume wo Miru

98126.description: "I think about the same things every day. I hope for the same things every day. Perhaps I was born in the wrong dimension; I feel that this is my true world... Maybe the world I was first born in was fake. Because- take a look, this world is beautiful. Only in this world do I feel happy."

98127.description: Mikaze-chan returns home from a festival with a goldfish. She soon learns that the world isn’t fair.

98128.description: An experiment goes wrong, an assistant turns into a cat. But not to worry, it can be reversed... kind of.

title.english: Momo Pro Z - AE Superstar Retsuden
title.native: ももプロZ AEスーパースター列
title.romaji: Momo Pro Z - AE Superstar Retsuden

98131.description: Pianist prodigies Shirou and Kurono are siblings who share a mutual rivalry, as well as a secret. When they play the piano, they can see the tune as an "apparition" in the form of a man. However, when Shirou becomes a high school student, he is no longer able to see it. He hides that fact from his sister and desperately continues practicing in order to catch up to her.

98138.description: A meek comic artist Nishi tries to win the heart of his lifelong crush, Myon, who is engaged to a muscle-bound trucker. After a gangster shoots up the coffee shop where Myon's sister works, Nishi is forced to be assertive, and takes the two women with him on an adventure of great proportions.

98139.description:
In the summer of 2016, an unknown alien organism invades Earth and annihilates 20% of the human race in a span of one month. However, survivors of this virus were either transformed into a hideous creature called "Worms" or into super-humans called the "Heteros". The heteros form a protection agency called the "ISO" to fight the worms. Haru, a young hetero but also a mischievous trouble maker, wants to join this agency in the fight. But it's no easy road.

(Source: Lezhin)

98140.description:
When her husband passed away, Shuko Yakumo lost her appetite for life, and with it, her love of cooking. But her neighbor Shohei Yamato brings an end to Shuko's solitary existence. A high school baseball player living on his own, Shohei has a seemingly bottomless stomach...and this presents a challenge that Shuko is only too happy to accept! As her days begin to revolve around her secret hobby of feeding Shohei, will Shuko rediscover the happiness life has to offer?

(Source: Square Enix)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.
98140.hashtag: #八雲さんは餌づけがしたい
synonyms: Yakumo san wa Edzuke ga Sitai.

title.native: 八雲さんは餌づけがしたい。

98146.description: The one-shot opens with two slightly different members of a yakuza group talking together at a family restaurant. The yakuza group is in the middle of a dispute, and some members visit a young man named "Damiyan" who has a mysterious power.

98147.description: When Mermaid Princess Ela's fish friend is captured and turned into a delectable meal, she goes to land to mourn his death and aid his passing into the great beyond... If only that was the end of the story. Follow Ela as she discovers the wonders of seafood.
synonyms: มื้อสุดเศร้าของเจ้าหญิงเงือก

title.native: 人魚姫のごめんねごはん

98148.description:
Jiro Azuma is descended from of a long line of shinobi, and he also can talk to animals. One day, he rescues a very unique black cat named Rago, a supernatural being, and is dragged into a secret supernatural war.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

98150.description: A narrative of self-discovery masquerading as a coming of age romance, a family composition drama, a procedural detective story, and a superpowered thriller. Sakuta Minami openly professes the many loves of her life: Matsumoto Leiji anime, her family, swimming, Magical Plastering Girl Buffalo Koteko, but the unanswered questions surrounding her mother's separation from her natural father have nagged her all her life. Moji Shouhei, an anime geek with prodigious talent for calligraphy, holds in his gifted hands both a physical key to the school roof of their high school as well as the figurative key to finally unraveling the mystery of Minami's father.

title.native: 子供はわかってあげない
殺戮のマトリクスエッジ

98152.description: The Oonishi family doesn't have a father anymore. They don't have much money. They don't even have a shower. Tenohira Size presents eight stories of a mother and her three children's day-to-day lives in the aftermath of divorce.

98154.description:
In order to conceal that he’s a werewolf, Coyote avoids getting too involved with humans. But Marleen, a pianist at a bar he frequents, is interested in him and just won’t take no for an answer. When Coyote unexpectedly goes into heat for the first time, Marleen catches him while he’s unable to maintain his human form and offers up a tempting invitation. Coyote wants to resist, but can he?

(Source: SuBLime)

98156.description: Kumoro Tsuyoshi is in his third year in middle school and is in the midst of studying for his entrance exams. He wants to go to the same school as his childhood friend, Kamijou Haru, who's two years his senior​ since she's his crush. Will he succeed?

98157.description:
He's always been by my side, and that was as natural as breathing to me. I’ve never imagined otherwise. Even from now on...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

98158.description: Almost immediately after getting a job, Honma Tarou, a 21-year-old college graduate, is transferred to a new location. It turns out that at the new place all staff are female, and it will take a lot of effort for Tarou to earn their respect.

98159.description:
This is an original JK story from Comiket 90!

Mana Sano is a high school girl who worked as a tutor. After a class, she couldn't go home due to a sudden storm. Her student's father invited her to stay until the rain stoped. After dinner, Mana was helping to wash dishes while chatting with the father, when his hand suddenly grabbed her from behind...

(Source: Booth, translated)

98165.description: On a dare, Nagami kisses a random guy that just happens to be walking down the street. He apologizes and just laughs it off with his friends, but when some days later he accidentally meets this person again, things take a rather unexpected turn.

98166.description:

98168.description:
Shoukichi is a stylist who struggles with being unpopular due to him being unfriendly and overly serious about everything. Fukusuke, a top stylist who is frivolous and sarcastic, starts working at Shoukichi’s salon. One night, Shoukichi lets Fukusuke stay over at his place because Fukusuke missed the last train. While Shoukichi is sleeping, Fukusuke climbs on top of him and pushes his dick in his face. Because of this perverted thing that Fukusuke does, Shoukichi begins to hate him more and more. However, as creepy things continue to happen to Shoukichi, his thoughts about Fukusuke begin to change…

Maybe he’s a prince…?
What happens to someone who is stubborn but passionate about something they really want….?
synonyms: คัลเลอร์เรซิพี

98169.description: Everyone would be happier if this boss was dead...

98170.description: This is how people experience a virtual Grimm fairy tale. Each fairy tale hides a cruel story of ambition, pain, and obsession.

98171.description:
"O, Hero!" With that cliched line, Kazuya Souma found himself summoned to another world and his adventure--did not begin. After he presents his plan to strengthen the country economically and militarily, the king cedes the throne to him and Souma finds himself saddled with ruling the nation! What's more, he's betrothed to the king's daughter now...?! In order to get the country back on its feet, Souma calls the wise, the talented, and the gifted to his side. Five people gather before the newly crowned Souma. Just what are the many talents and abilities they possess...?! What path will his outlook as a realist take Souma and the people of his country down? A revolutionary transferred-to-another-world administrative fantasy series starts here!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: 現実主義者の王国改造記～内政マシマシ、旅も入れてください～
ยุทธศาสตร์กู้ชาติของราชามือใหม่
現實主義勇者的王國重建記
