10. Boku no Oyomesan
11. Erobana

98817.description:
Hokaze Junko, one of the top “handmaidens” of Shokuhou Misaki, has always blended into the background of Tokiwadai–an easy feat when you go to an all-girls’ school full of powerful psychics. But when a ghostly figure starts stalking her, Junko is suddenly the center of attention! As Junko investigates her stalker, she starts to learn new things about her classmates…and herself!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.english: A Certain Scientific Railgun: Astral Buddy
title.native: とある科学の超電磁砲外伝 アストラル・バディ
title.romaji: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun Gaiden: Astral Buddy

98818.description:
In order to repay his father's debt of five hundred million yen, high school student Fuchigami Tatsuya must fight in a violent, no-holds-barred underground fighting tournament called MAD, in which the loser of a bout always dies.

Source: MU

98819.description:
The kind, smitten Chiaki and the scary yet reliable Kazuma are a long-term gay couple. Tomoe, the tomboy who knows of their relationship, asks to see them, and they find her with a large tummy and another life growing inside her. The father is unknown, and although Chiaki and Kazuma are exasperated with the chipper Tomoe, they help her out. Before they know it, the baby is born. The two men are relieved that Tomoe is acting like a proper mother, but one day, Tomoe comes to them with tears in her eyes and says, "Take care of her for me.......!" The bubbling motherly instincts, the increasing motherly skills, and the interrupted sex!? New territory for Tomo Kurahashi, author of "I want to do what lovers do.", this is a heart-warming story about the bond between two men, and familial love.

(Source: Renta!)

98821.description:
Graduate student Asahi suddenly has to care for his sister's five-year-old son, Masaki. Asahi barely has enough money to buy food for the two of them, but while in the supermarket, he bumps into Sora, his childhood friend. Although they haven't seen each other in six years, Sora offers to help out. He ends up moving in with Asahi and Masaki, and so begins their life of playing 'house'. However, Sora gets more and more touchy-feely as the days go by...... 'D-Don't! Masaki's in the next room......!!'

This manga contains the following works: 'Family Simulation!!' and 'I Love You At The Micro Level!!'

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Micro Tan'i de Kimi ga Suki!!

title.native: ふぁみりーしゅみれーしょん!!

98822.description:
High-schooler Ryoma Mikoshiba finds himself summoned to another world by the warmongering O’ltormea Empire. But Ryoma is no ordinary school boy – he has both talent and training in martial arts. Using his skills in martial arts to escape captivity and swearing revenge on the country that summoned him, Ryoma finds himself in a world where he can become stronger by absorbing the life force of whomever he slays – a world that fits his talents to a bloody T. Pursued by the O’ltormean court for killing an important official, Ryoma attempts to flee the border while keeping his identity hidden. But as he does, he encounters two twin sisters - Sara and Laura - an encounter that will change his fate. And so begins the epic tale of a young man and his journey of war and domination!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: บันทึกสงครามวอร์เทเนีย

98823.description:
High-schooler Ryoma Mikoshiba finds himself summoned to another world by the warmongering O’ltormea Empire. But Ryoma is no ordinary school boy – he has both talent and training in martial arts. Using his skills in martial arts to escape captivity and swearing revenge on the country that summoned him, Ryoma finds himself in a world where he can become stronger by absorbing the life force of whomever he slays – a world that fits his talents to a bloody T. Pursued by the O’ltormean court for killing an important official, Ryoma attempts to flee the border while keeping his identity hidden. But as he does, he encounters two twin sisters - Sara and Laura - an encounter that will change his fate. And so begins the epic tale of a young man and his journey of war and domination!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: บันทึกสงครามวอร์เทนเนีย

98824.description:
Adorable-looking model, Kubota Rei, hides a dark secret...And that is a strangulation kink and getting off on seeing the marks. But one day, all of this is revealed to the tabloids by an ex-girlfriend claiming domestic violence. Although he is deeply regretful that it happened, he does not change his behavior. His manager decides that if he can't stop it, might as well find an outlet. So he hires Miyoshi, a prostitute who is okay with any type of play. When they first meet, upon seeing Miyoshi's pale skin and hair, immediately falls for him...

Included in this volume is also a story on infidelity and love triangles. "Yurete, Fureru Made": A bitter tale about adults.

title.native: 揺れて、ふれるまで or 甘える首輪

98825.description: Yuki and Hayato are brothers that live alone in a run-down apartment. They were very close in the past, but now Yuki has distanced himself and Hayato doesn't know why. A dramatic story of two brothers with a twist.

title.native: Dear, クレイジーモンスター

98826.description:
When tragedy strikes during a wedding that would bring together the Fantasia Union and the Factory Alliance, Siluca finds herself with no choice but to forge a new future for the world. With the aid of Theo, a knight errant with great potential, she will go against the world’s order to achieve peace through the magical power of crests. And as Theo soon finds out, her methods are more than a little unorthodox!

(Source: VIZ Media)

98827.description:
"I'm a winner in life and knew nothing of losing."
"From the start, till the end, he's my rival."

Shimojou can have whatever he wants but deep down, finds life boring. Constantly searching for a thrill, he wanders off the path of an elite and descends into life as a yakuza-like lowlife. Then one day, he comes across a man who's a filthy piece of garbage. This is the man, who during his youth, was the only person who has given Shimojou the taste of defeat: Kuze.

"Bringing you down, is my mission."
"If you're doing this for money, how about letting me keep you as a pet, then?"

An intellectual ersatz yakuza lowlife and a homeless parasitic piece of garbage, their life together begins again, but just where will the future lead them...? The world that stood still during adolescence is carving out new tracks starting now!

98829.description:
A famous actor, a woman on the run and a handsome robot find themselves amongst a group of survivors after their plane crashes onto a deserted island. Romance, mayhem and hilarity ensue as they all try to survive their new surroundings and each other.

Source: (Spottoon)

98830.description:
Shingo works as a medical rep. for a pharmaceutical company. He's introduced by his customer to anesthesiologist Reiji, who works for a large hospital. When they first meet, Reiji has an ice-cold attitude and tells Shingo to get lost. He's a tough customer who's not willing to open up at all. Shingo's efforts pay off, though, as he gets invited to go with Reiji to a conference in the countryside! That night, Shingo finds a chance to get closer to Reiji. One hotel room, one bed, a crumpled robe, and an intense expression. "He's totally making a move here...... right?" Not only is he with a man, but it's that cold, straight-laced anesthesiologist... "Should we have sex? Just what the heck's the right answer!!!!?"

A hot medical rep. and a handsome anesthesiologist, embroiled in an adult affair!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Sur un malentendu, ça peut marcher !

98831.description:
Chisato Mizusawa is a reserved but excellent and pretty assistant manager in her company. She has a secret that only her husband Sora knows, which is that she likes drinking alcohol, and she can become very cute when she is drunk!

Even tonight, she gets relaxed and drunk with the cocktail Sora makes.

It's a "Yoidere (Drunken Dere)" cocktail comedy of Japan's closest husband and wife.

(Source: Shogakukan)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

title.native: お酒は夫婦になってから
title.romaji: Osake wa Fuufu ni Natte kara

98832.description:
A narcissistic apprentice devil suddenly appears before a lonely shut-in?

In order to pass his final exam, Tougo Nishizaki, an apprentice devil, makes a contract with the shut-in college student Sugishita Masato. He'll grant three of Masato's wishes in exchange for his chastity and life energy.

Another apprentice devil, Yoichi Murase, has a contract with Nishiima. His arrival brings the lives of these four together in a story you can't take your eyes off of!

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)

title.english: Love x Devil (Apperenticeship): An Apprentice Devil and the 3 Wishes
title.native: らぶ×デビ（仮）～見習い悪魔と3つの願い～
title.romaji: Love x Devil (Kari): Minarai Akuma to Mittsu no Negai

98834.description:
Suffering from heartbreak after being rejected by Poseidon, goddess of wisdom Athena becomes human to seek revenge... but as a high schoolboy. There she plots to befriend Poseidon’s reincarnation, Adrian, who doesn’t have the slightest clue about the world of gods. But will her sweet vengeance be thwarted by other opposing forces, or will her own one-sided love hinder her plans?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

98835.description: The story unfolds in Nazi Germany, when SS Reichsführer Heinrich Himmler commanded a top secret mission in Wewelsburg under the Führer. It follows Neun, the ninth child to carry Hitler's DNA, and his protector, Teo Baker, as they travel across the country on the run from the Nazis.
synonyms: นอยน์ เด็กชายหมายเลข 9

98836.description: A cute story about a couple and their dates.

98837.description:
1. Hajimari ni Deep Kiss (はじらいにディープキス)
2. Hajimari ni Motto Deep Kiss (はじらいにもっとディープキス)
3-4. Start Line Made Ato Ippo (スタートラインまであと一歩)
5. Hajimari ni Motto Deep Kiss After (はじらいにもっとディープキス after)

title.native: いやよいやよもキスのうち

98838.description:
Inspector Sudou is known for always succeeding in retrieving the items stolen by the notorious thief Grey, a master of disguise, who is able to steal the goods even though he sends the police a notice on what he intends to steal beforehand. How is Sudou able to get the stolen items back from this evasive burglar?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The seesaw game of distorted love
title.native: いびつな恋のシーソーゲーム
title.romaji: Ibitsu na Koi no Seesaw Game

98839.description:
Tatsumi, a lab technician, is severely haphephobic. After accidentally contracting an experimental virus, however, he finds himself craving touch… Particularly the touch of the man responsible for the incident, whom he's quarantined inside the laboratory with. Can love truly blossom from a relationship that started merely for the sake of sexual gratification, during a moment of insanity and uncertainty?

Note: Includes two chapters of the continuation to "Ai wa Sekai wo Sukuu no ka!? (愛は世界を救うのか!?)" and one extra chapter.

98840.description:
I don't want your father's... I want to exchange sakazuki with you, Yamato.
Yukio, son of the second-in-command of the Bidou Yakuza group, learns from the boss's son, Yamato, that the boss doesn't have long to live. In the face of Yamato's determination to take on the group despite only being a high school student, Yukio falls for him, and they unofficially exchange sakazuki. The two of them are certain that this bond will last a lifetime, but...

98841.description:
"It seems like it feels good when you hold your pee in?" "Is it safe to let your bra straps be visible?"

There is just too much to worry about being a high school girl! A realistic school girl everyday life short manga that brings back nostalgic memories, with a little fetishism included.

(Source: Official site)

98842.description:
"Hanako-san, Hanako-san... are you there?"

At Kamome Academy, rumors abound about the school's Seven Mysteries, one of which is Hanako-san. Said to occupy the third stall of the third floor girls' bathroom in the old school building, Hanako-san grants any wish when summoned. Nene Yashiro, an occult-loving high school girl who dreams of romance, ventures into this haunted bathroom... but the Hanako-san she meets there is nothing like she imagined! Kamome Academy's Hanako-san... is a boy!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Hanako-Kun e os mistérios do colégio Kamome
ฮานาโกะคุง วิญญาณติดที่
Hanako kun - I sette misteri dell'Accademia Kamome
Hanako-Kun y los misterios de la Academia Kamome

title.native: 地縛少年 花子くん

98844.description:
I want to protect you forever... Because you and I have no other loved ones in this world.

The coming-of-age story of two orphans who become best friends.
synonyms: I will be waiting for you in 1999

98845.description:
Yeon Janghwa is a more or less average college student: she attends a pretty good university, is pretty good-looking, and has a nice boyfriend. Her twin sister, Hong-ryeon, on the other hand, is the opposite. Being the good sister she is, Janghwa sets out to help her twin sister... but at what price? The truth is in the details.

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: แฝดที่หายไป

98848.description: Two young boys, feel very anxious to face the circumstances of reality, what kind of decision will they take?

98849.description:
The adventure of earthling Sora.

(Source: Weekly Shounen Jump, translated)

Note: Third place in the 10th Golden Future Cup competition in 2015.

98850.description: Sakuraba Souta has always been the best at everything, school, work, almost anything. This includes picking up the ladies. He claims he has the perfect life, except that his childhood friend Ukaji Tsumugu, can beat him at almost anything, making him Souta’s number one rival. That is until one of the women Souta plays around with decides she wants more. How will Souta get out of this situation? Will he do anything, even if it means begging his number one rival for help?

title.native: 制服をまとえば、うまく嘘がつけたのに。
title.romaji: Seifuku wo Matoeba, Umaku Uso ga Tsuketa no ni.

98852.description:
Photography club student Shiro Akagi wants to submit a piece for the contest but doesn't have a photo he feels is good enough. He certainly knows what he wants to take a photo, though: muscles.♡ Shiro LOVES muscular bodies... and he has just found his muse. Akio Suga is a track and field club member who refuses every plea Shiro makes for Akio to be his model. Anybody who takes a look at the runner would be astonished by his fine figure. Who knew Akio had such strong insecurity about his... nipples? Shiro MUST find a way to capture his ideal body.

(Source: Futekiya)
synonyms: Gohoubi Chikubi - Kouhai ni Model ni Nare to Semarareteimasu
ごほうび乳首～後輩にモデルになれと迫られています

98853.description:
"That summer was a mistake." Hajime Nonokawa ends up accidentally reuniting with his childhood friend Keisuke Koya after going back to his hometown for the first time since it was turned into a reservoir 12 years ago. 12 years ago, Hajime suddenly realized he had feelings for his friend, but he chose to hide those feelings away... What will happen during this reunion? Will his feelings resurface again?

(Source: Renta!)

98854.description: Takashima works in sales. One day, Kitamura, a kouhai at work, finds Takashima's cellphone with his own face as the wallpaper. Takashima wants to keep the fact that he is a narcissist secret, so Kitamura agrees to be discrete if, in exchange, Takashima becomes his sex friend. What will happen when Takashima discovers that Kitamura suffers from erectile disfuntion?

title.native: 高島孝一郎の理想の恋人
title.romaji: Takashima Kouichirou no Risou no Koibito

98855.description: A third-year high school student helps a really cute girl on the street. On their first date, the girl drags the boy to a hotel, and the boy soon realizes that the "girl" is a boy.
synonyms: There is No Chance of Loving You

title.native: 好きになんて、なるわけない!

98857.description:
After spending most of her youth fielding the attention of countless wealthy suitors, Suhee Kim finally finds true love with a steady boyfriend named Jinsu Han. But then tragedy strikes, and Suhee is murdered in cold blood.

To Suhee's surprise, she is immediately reincarnated as a baby girl named Sanghee Kim, who just so happens to be a princess! Plus, she is fully conscious of her past life. There's just one problem: in this society, women are seen as totally inferior, even princesses. Appalled by the treatment of women, Sanghee is determined to change the kingdom's patriarchal ways. Will Sanghee be able to succeed, or will she be stuck living her second life being treated as a lowly woman?

(Source: Boom Manga)
synonyms: 転生したら王女様になりました

title.english: They Say I Was Born a King's Daughter

98858.description:
Satoko Tawada, a 30-year-old office worker at a sporting goods company, encounters Mashuu Hayami, a 12-year-old boy, playing soccer in a park at night. She was treated cruelly by a former lover, he is dealing with a high-handed and uninvolved family. Both are burdened with loneliness, and they sense that the other has something that they’re searching for...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

98859.description: Once upon a time, humans hunted witches... Now it's their turn!

98865.description: A boy who worries about his height fears an impossibly tall presence in his home.

98867.description:
Iris was born on a rainy day dyed with emptiness, regret, and fond memories. As an android, Iris must obey her master's orders and cater to her every need, but her creator, Professor Umbrella, wishes for a more intimate and more 'human' relationship with her. 

To cultivate an organic connection between master and servant, Professor Umbrella helps Iris to develop a sense of identity and pushes her into taking an active role in her own growth.

This is a story about a female robot born on a rainy day.

This is a story about rainy days.

This is a story about how a mechanical maiden born on a rainy day became a soft-hearted and free-willed girl.

title.english: Iris on Rainy Days: My Homework
title.native: 雨の日のアイリス『僕の宿題』
title.romaji: Ame no Hi no Iris: Boku no Shukudai

98869.description:
32-year-old Futaba Kiryuu is a manga artist that writes for a weekly shounen magazine. Her latest ongoing manga is a romantic comedy, "Bocchi no Ore kara Riaju no Omaera ni Ittoku" (A Loner Like Me's Got a Lot to Say about You Normies out There) or "Bottoku" for short. It is a best-seller and has an anime adaption on the works. But the truth is, she's completely clueless about romance.

The days go on as she continues on working on her manga with her manga assistants, but soon, one of her assistants, Hiro Asakura (she dubs him as "Assassin" because of his cold and intimidating demeanor), and the anime scriptwriter for the "Bottoku" anime, Kitamura Kyosuke (social media dubs him "The Tactician" for his notoriously clever execution in the anime he's worked in) grow an interest in her and eventually make a move on her. How will Futaba fare in this love triangle when her knowledge of romance is next to nothing?

Note: Volume 3 includes one extra
98869.hashtag: #桐生先生は恋愛がわからない
synonyms: Miss Kiryu Doesn't Know What Love is.

98870.description:
Death Castle, the seat of power in the Demon World, is home to three demon kings...and a toddler?! The High Demon King, Death Mask, and his co-rulers Demon King Giant Rock and Demon King Dark Knight find that though they command powerful legions of evil, they aren't immune to a child's cries...and so the sweet, innocent human child Maris will grow up under their care! After all, how hard can raising a child be...?

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: The devil is not so black as he is painted.

98871.description: Surh Jung-woo developed Gynophobia because of his trauma when he was younger. Even as a college student he is still afraid of woman, but Yoon hae-soo is a angel like existence for Jung-woo because of his fear. He starts dating after thinking he could trust Hae-soo, but while putting everything he has on line for her he falls into debt and gets cornered. After he gets betrayed by Hae-soo the person to save him is the most beautiful girl of this college, and the famous professor Pi Eun-na. What is this beautiful teacher after, and why did she help jung-woo?

synonyms: The Yuri You Can’t Get Without Sex

title.native: セックスしないと出られない百合

98879.description:
Two old friends meet after long separation. Maruyama asks Osawa for a favor and he agrees but with certain conditions...

Note: Includes the one-shot "Hanbun wa Anata ni (半分はあなたに)" and one extra chapter.

title.native: 好きです、全部ください

98880.description:
Editor for a women's magazine, Izuki is suddenly told to negotiate an interview for his column with in a haughty and sarcastic man who tells him "You'll come crying to me asking for interview after hearing this." That man is a young up-and-coming conductor, Akito Sasaki, and Izuki's senior from high school. Izuki reluctantly goes to his concert, but leaves it on cloud nine, barely able to walk. Sakaki takes advantage of his state to make him melt with a kiss.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

title.native: それでも俺のものになる
title.romaji: Soredemo Ore no Mono ni Naru

98882.description: A sweet, sincere story about a developing high school love.

98886.description:
The story of one woman keeping the Demon King on schedule!

The Demon King is awake at last and hellbent on world domination–but first he needs a secretary. He finds a human to organize his devilish plot, and she’s perfect for the job. So perfect, in fact, that she’s steadily losing her grip on her humanity. Thanks to her smarts, super skills, and secretarial wiles, it’s only a matter of time before the Demon King’s destructive dreams come true!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Includes chapter 9.5.

98887.description: When given a magic lamp, 37-year-old Tooru Sugamo wishes for his childhood dream to come true and gains all the powers he thought up once upon a time as a wannabe novelist, but it turns out an eighth grader's ideas aren't the most original - or the kinds of things you'd want causing havoc in your married life.

98888.description: During WWIII an US Navy boat sinks at the bottom of an ocean (well actually the whole North America disappears from the face of earth too). 8 years later a group of investigators are called to recover the boat and discover why the boat had sunk.

98889.description: Within the winding streets of Kyoto's geisha district, there lives a 16 year old girl named Kiyo. After failing to become a Maiko, an apprentice traditional Japanese performer, Kiyo works as the caterer for her troupe. This is the story of her daily life.
synonyms: Kiyo in Kyoto: From the Maiko House

title.native: 舞妓さんちのまかないさん

98890.description: Set during the Meiji period, Chirori follows the eponymous character, a hard-working young woman who's an attendant at a coffee shop in Yokohama.

98892.description: A girl tries to "buy" her female classmate with money.

98894.description:
In the distant future, the 'Earth Queen Championship' decides who will become the bride of the heir to the throne that rules the entire cosmos! Only one thing matters: strength! Female warriors from across the galaxy gather on Earth to claim the Queen's Crown!

The interspecies sci-fi battle saga begins... now!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

98895.description: Those who are troubled by strange phenomenon go to the forty-fourth room of the fourth floor of the fourth hall of Higashisei University’s Literature Department. There they will find Zettaijou Araya, a tall, pale, and handsome collector of all materials related to youkai. Perpetually clad in a black haori, he consults people suffering from supernatural problems. The season is spring, and the university campus is crowded with new students. One day, a freshman by the name of Yunoyama Ayane decides to pay a visit to a certain room…
synonyms: Apparition Studies: Lectures by Zettaijou Senpai
Lectures in Monster Studies by Zettaijou
Mr. Absolute Castle's Course in Ghost Knowledge

title.native: 絶対城先輩の妖怪学講座

98896.description:
Kenichi Nishikasai is a 31 years old man but with a body of a middle schooler. While trying his new onahole abeautiful lady genie appears, she is actually a demon trapped by gods she angered. He have 3 wishes to make, before his soul is taken away. Read as he waste his wishes for his soul.

From the author of Boku Girl.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

title.native: 叶えて！ジンニャーちゃん！！

98899.description:
The true meaning of friendship is explored in this story about Shihyeon, who was born deaf, and Youngwoo, who acquires a disability later in life.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

98900.description:
One day Arc wakes up in the world of his favorite MMORPG…and discovers that he’s become exactly like his game character, a heroic knight who just so happens to be a skeleton! The whole skull-for-a-head thing is maybe going to be a problem. Arc resolves to keep a low profile, lest anyone mistake him for a monster, but he can’t quite manage to turn a blind eye to the troubles of his new world. Adventure awaits, and the Skeleton Knight will be there to meet it!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: 骸骨骑士大人异世界冒险中
บันทึกการเดินทางต่างโลกของท่านอัศวินกระดูก

title.romaji: Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu

98901.description:
The hilarious adventures of the eldest apprentice of a sect who has a problem with his brain.

Dong Fang Xian Yun is reincarnated as the eldest disciple of the Care-free sect. But the only thing that goes through his mind is to make sure he doesn't end up dying by the hands of the "main character". Read as he makes no sense to his sibling disciples while avoiding flags left and right.

Included chapters: 10.5
synonyms: Our Big Brother's Brain Has A Pit
Our Big Brother's Mind Has A Problem
My Sect's Senior Disciple Has a Hole in His Brain
There's a Pit in My Senior's Brain

title.romaji: Wo Jia Da Shixiong Naozi You Keng

98904.description:
One day, an ordinary high school girl by the name of Ichika Kotobuki saves a dog on the verge of death on the side of the road. However, all of the sudden, the dog transforms into a human. As a consequence, Ichika gets dragged into an event that runs once in a thousand years known as "Eto Battle"!

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

98905.description: Miharu is smart, attractive and talented. One could say he's been playing life in "easy mode." That is until a teddy bear steals his wallet and a strange man comes out of an arcade game and demands Miharu play a game; the D-game! What's worse, the man even claims to be from the future. What will happen when Miharu must play to survive?

title.native: ワールドエンド:デバッガー

98907.description:
Kouta, who has invited to share his hand-made lunch to the popular and handsome boy -Shibusawa senpai, which fainted due to hunger inside school.

Shibusawa senpai has a small apetite an is rummored not to eat hand-made obentos, eats happily as if he liked it. After that, they spend the day together, with Kouta’s handmade lunch. But one day, Shibusawa senpai suddenly changed! Calling Kouta saying “Kouta is delicious!” And that way he’s pushed down…?!

(Source: Whitelies Fansub)

98908.description:
Serialization of a oneshot from Harta 33.

Nicola never really felt like she fit in around other humans…so she came to the demons’ world instead! Together with her demon friend Simon, Nicola travels far and wide, meeting many monsters along the way. With Nicola, every day on the road is a new adventure!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.
synonyms: Le fantastique voyage de Nicola au pays des démons

title.english: Nicola Traveling Around the Demons’ World
title.native: ニコラのおゆるり魔界紀行

98909.description:
On an island in the ocean, prisoners are sent to mine a mysterious and dangerous ore. One day, a soldier named Credo is sent to the island as a guard...

Note: This one-shot was the winner of Shinman GP 2017.

98910.description:
In Tokyo lies a small restaurant called “Western Cuisine Nekoya,” ordinary in every way—save one. Every Saturday, its door connects to another world! Follow along as a cavalcade of curious guests from half-elves to samurai, dragons, halflings and vampires enter its premises, all with the same goal in mind: to fill their stomachs with the most mouth-watering of foods.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ร้านอาหารลับต่างโลก

98911.description:
By all appearances, Western Restaurant Nekoya is a normal restaurant serving normal people—but unbeknownst to the regulars, it also attracts an alternative clientele. Every Saturday, all manner of fantastical beings come to dine, and what is familiar fare to humans can be downright exotic for visitors from beyond. To these customers, Nekoya is known by a different name: Restaurant to Another World.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ร้านอาหารลับต่างโลก

98912.description: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Raihousha-hen (魔法科高校の劣等生 来訪者編) is the manga adaption of the 'Visitor Arc' from the 9th to the 11th light novels.

title.english: The Irregular At Magic High School: Visitor Arc

神さまSHOPでチートの香り

98920.description:
One day, Kyouji Himuro hears a knock on his door. Opening it up, he finds that he is transported to another world.

But his new life is not good. He has no fighting skill, no money, and no way to make food. While dumpster diving, Kyouji discovers seeds and comes up with a plan to grow his own food. However, his plans change when he realizes that these seeds grow monsters...

title.native: 異世界ですが魔物栽培しています。

In the city where the desires storm, the murder game with a prize of 100 million has begun.

98934.description: Kine Machiko is a thirty-something office worker, who loves nothing more than watching movies and writing her review blog. She hides her passion for movies from her co-workers due to unpleasant past experiences, but she still wants friends with whom she can share her love of movies. What will be the next movie she watches? What dark, geeky secret will haunt her next? Will she ever make any movie friends?
synonyms: I love cinema, I am lonely.

title.native: 木根さんの1人でキネマ

98935.description: Unlike many cheerful students around her, Sei has a rather pessimistic view. That is until she meets a mysterious boy called Hana. Because of his words, she has started to think a bit differently. As she meets him again, she finds out that there is something unusual about him...
synonyms: I Fall in First Love for You Many Times
Boku wa Nando Demo Kimi ni Hajimete no Koi wo Suru

98940.description: The Kuga House is the most prestigious deer family in Nara Prefecture. Shiraha, their heir, is attached to childhood human friend, Sousuke. Shiraha is popular and loved by all, while Sousuke is a mere servant of the house. But he is always telling Sousuke how much he likes him. Even though he feels special to be singled out by the beautiful and esteemed Shiraha, he knows that there is a line that he cannot cross. But! During mating season, Shiraha can’t control himself anymore and he comes on to Sousuke! Since then, the scales of their well-balanced relationship tips and Sousuke’s virtue falls into danger!

98941.description:
An elegant love story begins between a refined, old-fashioned girl and a perfect gentleman. Having been raised with great care by her grandfather, Suzu Arisugawa is a traditional girl at heart. Her hobby is rakugo storytelling, her curfew is at 6 p.m., and she’s completely clueless when it comes to romance. One day on the train, she meets Nomiya, a boy who’s popular among both guys and girls alike. Though he’s always kind to her, Suzu can’t help but to feel flustered every time they’re together. Enjoy the sweet story about two characters you’ll want to keep reading about forever.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

不思議の国の有栖川さん

title.native: ふしぎの国の有栖川さん

title.native: となりの星の王子さま
E・S・P! エロ・スケベ・パワー!

98946.description:
In the Kura + Kuri / Rewrite Clinic series:

V.1 - Kura + Kuri / Rewrite Clinic

V.2 - Raki + Kuri / Lucky Clinic

98948.description: Ikoma has always wanted to be a voice actor. Luckily for him the famous voice actress Yuzuki Hashimoto has started to give lessons for young aspiring voice actors. But it soon turns out that many of her methods are quite unorthodox since they involve having sex for some reason.

98949.description:
On a certain day, two high school students Mina and Hiromu lost their lives after getting swept up in a traffic accident. In the realm of the dead, they discover that one of them has one more year of "life" left but are unable to find out whose. That precious time is hence divided between the two. They return to their lives, only to head face to face with a cruel reality. Regardless of what the fate that awaits them may be, it will certainly be shocking.

(Source: Batoto)
synonyms: to dream for one last time.

title.native: 命を分けたきみと、人生最後の夢をみる
title.romaji: Inochi wo Waketa Kimi to, Jinsei Saigo no Yume wo Miru

98954.description: A connected anthology about artists living in a rowhouse in Kyoto.

98958.description: If he grabs a sword, he looks like a beast full of blades. During the Edo Period, there was a rumor of a certain monster called "Mononote" running over all the Nakasendou Route. Okota, a traveling girl, meets Hitatsura, a boy with strange "reversed hands." Ninja's daily work during peace times! Meet the hard and magnificent world of Edo ninja's humble jobs.
synonyms: Mononote: An Edo Era Ninja Scroll
もののて 江戸奇傑忍者絵巻

98961.description: Since he was a child, Ryuuichi Naruhodou's dream was to become a defense attorney, protecting the innocent when no one else would. However, when the rookie lawyer finally takes on his first case under the guidance of his mentor Chihiro Ayasato, he realizes that the courtroom is a battlefield. In these fast paced trials, Ryuuichi is forced to think outside the box to uncover the truth of the crimes that have taken place in order to prove the innocence of his clients. Gyakuten Saiban: Sono "Shinjitsu", Igi Ari! follows Ryuuichi as he tackles cases to absolve the falsely accused of the charges they face. It will not be easy—standing in his path is the ruthless Reiji Mitsurugi, a prosecutor who will stop at nothing to hand out guilty verdicts. With his back against the wall, the defense attorney must carefully examine both evidence and witness testimony, sifting through lies to solve the mystery behind each case. With a shout of "objection!," the battle in the courtroom begins!

title.native: 逆転裁判 ～その「真実」、異議あり!～
スクラップド・プリンセス

98974.description: Jumped on a truck and reincarnated in a different world, a fellow beautiful woman who had assembled a party several decades ago was awaiting me. "Long time no see Master" Restart in Easy mode from level 1 in a peaceful world that I once saved! Follow the world's strongest sage maid, train slave girls to train, convert thieves girls, increase their buddies! Even the luxurious residence and the strongest equipment are kept! The next life will go with the most powerful new game that does not take self-weight every single one !!

title.native: 自重しない元勇者の強くて楽しいニューゲーム
title.romaji: Jichou Shinai Motoyuusha no Tsuyokute Tanoshii New Game

98975.description:
The novels center on a bar called "Nobu" — located in Kyoto, Japan, but with a door that is connected to the bar in another world. The visitors include denizens of the other world, and customers seek out its excellent "Toriaezu Nama" ale and cuisine.

(Source: Anime News Network)

98979.description:
Thirty years after World War III, Japan has suffered immense damage from a dangerous weapon known as a "Man Bomb" which affected nearly all Japanese men and rendered them unable to fight, with other men giving their lives for their country. Heihachi Edajima, an Otokojuku veteran and survivor of the Man Bomb, starts up a new facility known as Onnajuku, a tough combat training facility, and begins training several Japanese women to fight for their country.

The manga follows Momoko Tsurugi, a descendant of former protagonist Momotarou Tsurugi, who recently enrolls in Onnajuku. As spirited and tenacious as her ancestor, Momoko's catchphrase is "As a woman, I ain't dying! I, Momoko Tsurugi, will show you my burning youth!"

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Otoku Juku Gaiden: Kurenai!! Onna Juku
Otokojuku Side Story: Crimson!! Women's Private School

title.native: 男塾外伝 紅!! 女塾

98981.description:
Ten years is enough time for a childhood friend to completely change- Baek Sumi, a leader of the neighborhood kids at a young age, protected her small and weak friend Kang Hwon from the other kids. However, at the high school entrance ceremony, the two met again as complete opposites! All the students are scared of Hwon's power, and it's coming back to Baek Sumi's ordinary high school life.

Included chapters: 0

98982.description:
Our protagonist was reincarnated in a world with goblin and dragon... but his optimal job is "villager". Using the cheat "getting one chance to redo life after death" he will show you what a villager can do.

Included chapters: 9.5
synonyms: I Am a Villager, What About It?
I'm Just a Villager, So What?

98983.description:
I'm the strongest damn villager on the planet! Reincarnated into a fantasy world, Ryuto Maclaine was assigned the most ordinary class of all: villager. No heroic bloodline, no divine blessings - just a dirt-poor farm boy from a no-name village.
His childhood friends? Oh, just a cheat-tier hero named Cordelia and a genius sage named Moses. At fifteen, Ryuto's life comes to an abrupt end... Courtesy of Moses stabbing him in the back.
But death isn't the end. That's when his true cheat kicks in: return from death - a one-time-only skill that lets him rewind his life in this world.
Armed with his second chance and an indomitable will called unyielding, Ryuto vows to rise again. Even if he's just a villager, he'll save the hero, rewrite his fate, and punch his way to the top!
The rise of Ryuto the villager begins now - Try to keep up.

(Source: Hanashi Media)
synonyms: I am a villager, what about it?

title.english: I'm Just a Villager, So What?

98984.description: Originally published by Red Rising Books on May 23, 2007 before getting discontinued. As of 2019, the web novel was picked up and published by HJ Bunko.

title.native: 魔界帰りの劣等能力者

98991.description:
Hanami Sushiro is awkward when it comes to love and she doesn't know the proper distance for human relationships. You might as well call her a misanthrope. Her peaceful life is disturbed when she meets the unpredictable Ai Ojiya who just won't leave her alone!

The slapstick love comedy of an aloof and love-hating loner girl and a loved handsome stalker opens!

title.native: ミザントロープな彼女

98994.description: In this world, Makai, every Demon gets a Familiar summoned using their magic. Patty, a Demon Girl who's magic is so weak she can't even summon an animal is forced to get a famliar. So, reluctantly, she chooses an older human named Norman as her familiar. Norman has an incredible fascination with examining all types of lifeforms around Makai, claiming he loves learning about them. This weird combination of a weak demon girl and a goofy old man leads to a journey of adventures the two go through.

title.native: ウチの使い魔がすみません

98996.description:
Follows Shishibara Miko, Atou Mutsuki, and their friends as they enjoy their daily lives by trying to understand the true meaning of human life.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Dioti Manual: Gods act on love affair
